paragraphs: i3 Verticals sells integrated software to public sector customers. The portfolio is described as specialized platforms, each meant to work as a system of record for one domain of government operations. The site groups those platforms into transportation, justice, public utilities, public administration, and education.

The education platform is described as software for K-12 staff and families. One page states the customer base differently, as small- and medium-sized businesses and other organizations in strategic vertical markets. Support is described as a phone call to a support team available anytime.

quote.text: i3 Verticals delivers a portfolio of specialized platforms designed to manage the most essential operations in government.
